exposure: placental and umbilical cord pathologies (e.g., placental hypoplasia, necrotizing chorioamnionitis, avascular villi)
maternal and fetal clinical factors (e.g., medical disorders, hypertensive disorder)
cohort: The study included 250 women who delivered stillborn fetuses (>=28 weeks' gestation) and 250 maternal-age-matched controls who delivered livebirths.
finding: Various placental and umbilical cord pathologies, including placental hypoplasia, necrotizing chorioamnionitis, and avascular villi, were significantly associated with stillbirth.
